name: alchemist-playbook
description: Evidence-based training-recipe advisor (煉丹調參) distilled from published runs: LLaMA 1-3, OLMo 1-3, DeepSeek-V3, SmolLM2, Kimi K2, GLM-5, PivotRL, Agents-A1, EvoLM, LFM2, VibeThinker, FAC-Synthesis, Zephyr, Tulu 3, SimPO, ORPO, QLoRA, Whisper, OWSM, wav2vec 2.0, HuBERT. Covers training hyperparameters, run debugging (loss spikes, NaN, divergence), pretraining/SFT/DPO/RLHF/RLVR/agentic-RL/LoRA/QLoRA/speech recipe design, compute and token budgets, per-stage eval suites and release gates, and HTML-artifact experiment tracking.
